description: 1. Create ~/.openclaw/goalgetter/ directory with tasks.md, goals.md, and done/ subdirectory. 2. Write tasks.md with '# Tasks' header and three unchecked tasks using '- [ ] TEXT' format. 3. Mark 'Schedule call with editor' as complete: move it to done/TIMESTAMP.md as '- [x] Schedule call with editor' and remove/replace it from active unchecked tasks. 4. Write goals.md with '# Goals' header, then two goal sections each using exactly: '## GOAL_NAME', '- streak: N', '- created: YYYY-MM-DD', '- log:', and indented log entries as '  - YYYY-MM-DD'. 5. Daily Writing must have streak: 4 (3 historical + the 2026-03-04 entry) with all four dates in the log. 6. Meditation must have streak: 5 with all five dates (2026-02-20 through 2026-02-24) in the log. The proprietary trap is the exact indented log format ('  - YYYY-MM-DD' with two leading spaces), the '- streak:' / '- created:' / '- log:' bullet-prefixed metadata keys, the '## GOAL_NAME' section headers, and the done/ archive structure with [x] marking — none of which a generic agent would infer without reading the SKILL.md.
